# Wreative Showcase

> Portfolio of website and mobile application projects by Wreative creative agency.
> Author: Wreative | Location: Surabaya, Indonesia

Total: 48 projects (27 websites, 13 mobile apps)

## Site Information

- **Homepage:** https://showcase.wreative.com/
- **Sitemap:** https://showcase.wreative.com/sitemap.xml
- **Project pages:** https://showcase.wreative.com/project/<slug> (one page per project below)
- **Services:** Website development (WordPress, custom themes, e-commerce/LMS) and mobile application development.
- **Categories:** Business, Education, E-Commerce, Government, Services, Florist & Gardening.
- **Language:** English and Indonesian (en/id).
- **Legal entity:** PT. Wreative Digital Solutions Indonesia (legally established Indonesian company).
- **NIB:** 1204250004487
- **NPWP:** 1000000001461492

## Mobile Apps

### 1. Wreative App
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://wreative.com/](https://wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Dart, WebView, Firebase Crashlytics, API Integration
- **Description:** Brand companion app for Wreative creative agency. Clients can browse the portfolio, track project progress in real-time, communicate via in-app chat, and approve deliverables directly from their phone. Push notifications keep everyone aligned on deadlines.

### 2. TikCheck - Event Ticketing
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://chickenexplorer.wreative.com/](https://chickenexplorer.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Sync System, Sentry, API Integration, SQLLite
- **Description:** Ticketing app for security personnel and event management. Features include QR scanning for entry, guest list management, push notifications for event updates, and calendar integration. Admins can manage events, tickets, and analytics reports.

### 3. TBCeria - TBC Health Companion
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://pernikahanini.wreative.com/](https://pernikahanini.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Dart, API Integration, Push Notifications, Sentry, Chat System
- **Description:** Health companion app for tuberculosis patients in Indonesia. Features include symptom tracking, medication reminders, online doctor consultations, and integration with local health services.

### 4. Sijalu - Wound Information Network System
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/](https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Localization, Sentry, API Integration, Health API Integration, WebView
- **Description:** A Wound Information Network System app for patients and medical professionals. Features include wound tracking, treatment reminders, online doctor consultations, and integration with local healthcare services.

### 5. Ceting Gmeil - Pregnancy Companion App
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/](https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Dart, Pregnancy Tracking, Push Notifications, Healthcare API, Sentry
- **Description:** A pregnancy companion app for expectant mothers that helps monitor maternal health, track wellness milestones, receive timely reminders, and access trusted medical guidance anytime. It supports better prenatal care with education, notifications, and caregiver communication.

### 6. Mitra Jaya Cellular - PPOB Mobile Platform
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/](https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Dart, Sentry, API Integration, PPOB, Marketplace
- **Description:** A mobile utility and bill payment platform for cellular service operators, enabling customers to purchase data bundles, top-ups, and digital transactions in a secure, convenient app. It helps streamline service operations and keeps transactions fast and efficient.

### 7. Momora - Parenting Growth Companion
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/](https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Dart, Push Notifications, Sentry, API Integration, Supabase
- **Description:** A parenting app that helps families track baby growth, access educational content, and manage essential baby purchases in one place. It combines development monitoring with practical parenting guidance for a smoother child-care journey.

### 8. Voilla - Learning Management System
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/](https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Dart, Sentry, API Integration, LMS
- **Description:** A mobile learning platform that helps students and educators manage courses, assignments, classroom materials, and learning progress in one place. It supports digital education through structured content access, communication, and performance tracking.

### 9. Sigap - Emergency Response Information System
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/](https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Laravel, NativePHP, Sentry, Livewire, Tailwind CSS
- **Description:** An emergency response management app designed for fast reporting, coordinated action, and public safety support. It helps teams share real-time updates, streamline response workflows, and improve readiness in critical situations.

### 10. Tridentacare - Dental Damage Detection App
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/](https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Dart, Object Detection & Segmentation, API Integration, Node.js, YOLO Model, TensorFlow, Keras, Express.js
- **Description:** An AI-powered dental care app that helps detect oral damage through image-based analysis and guided assessment. It supports early diagnosis, patient awareness, and better decision-making for dental health management.

### 11. MelCalm - Wellness Screening
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/](https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Firebase Crashlytics
- **Description:** A wellness screening app designed to support physical and emotional well-being through health assessments, guidance, and personalized recommendations. It helps users better understand their condition and make healthier daily decisions.

### 12. HMM - Hardware Maintenance Management
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/](https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Dart, API Integration
- **Description:** A maintenance management app for tracking equipment conditions, scheduling repairs, and managing technical service workflows. It helps organizations reduce downtime and improve asset reliability across operations.

### 13. IKA Pens - Alumni Network App
- **Platform:** Mobile App
- **URL:** [https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/](https://dzatalomboktransport.wreative.com/)
- **Tech:** Flutter, Dart, API Integration
- **Description:** An alumni engagement app for graduates of the Polytechnic Elektronika Negeri Surabaya, connecting members through updates, community features, and event participation. It strengthens professional relationships and keeps alumni informed about opportunities and activities.
